responsibility: Declares the `rustc_middle` arena allocation universe by listing the middle-layer data types that may be stored in the crate’s typed arenas and by tagging which of those arena-allocated forms also need decoder support for incremental and metadata deserialization. This file is the allocation contract shared by `TyCtxt`-backed storage, MIR/THIR bodies, type-checking results, query outputs, and other long-lived middle-layer structures.
